04 — The Story

A peace sign with a bite.

ENFIGHTEN started with one idea: the only way to lasting peace is through strength. Peace isn't weakness, and kindness isn't softness. The fangs under the peace sign say it plainly — calm on the surface, sharp underneath. It's for the people who could, but choose not to.

Built on 40 years in the arts. Gear you wear to represent. Stay kind. Stay dangerous.
